treatments.name: Russian Lip Filler
treatments.intro: A precision-led lip treatment designed around shape, lift and proportion—not a one-size-fits-all trend.

faq.a: The plan is built around your proportions and desired finish. Fatima’s public treatment philosophy prioritises facial harmony and staged results over chasing volume.
The current Russian Lip appointment listed on Faces is 0.7ml. The right plan is confirmed during your assessment.
Longevity varies with metabolism, product and lifestyle. Your practitioner will explain realistic expectations at consultation.

treatments.name: Facial Balancing
treatments.intro: A considered, multi-area approach that looks at the face as a whole to create a more harmonious profile.

faq.a: That depends on your anatomy and goals. Packages are flexible and the consultation is used to decide where treatment adds genuine value.

faq.q: Do I need everything at once?
faq.a: No. A staged plan can often be the most refined route and helps protect natural proportions.

treatments.name: Anti-Wrinkle
treatments.intro: Consultation-led treatment for a fresher, rested appearance while protecting the character of your face.

faq.q: How many areas do I need?
faq.a: One, two and three-area options are listed. Your assessment determines the most appropriate plan.

faq.q: When will I see a change?
faq.a: Results develop gradually rather than instantly. Your practitioner will outline the expected timeline and review process.

treatments.name: Skin Boosters
treatments.intro: Injectable hydration options chosen to support radiance, texture and a healthy-looking skin finish.

faq.q: Which skin booster is right for me?
faq.a: Injectox lists several options including Lumi Pro, Baby Glow, Seventy Hyal, Aqua Shine and Profhilo. Selection depends on your skin and goals.

faq.q: Can it be combined with microneedling?
faq.a: The clinic’s public education highlights combination planning. Suitability, order and timing should be confirmed at consultation.

treatments.name: Microneedling
treatments.intro: A collagen-supporting treatment for clients seeking smoother, more even and revitalised-looking skin.

faq.a: Some clients value a single refresh; texture and scarring goals often benefit from a planned course.
You will receive aftercare tailored to your treatment. SPF, gentle skincare and avoiding heat or active ingredients are commonly discussed.

treatments.name: Advanced Facials
treatments.intro: From Glass Skin to extraction-led and medical-grade facial options, chosen around what your skin needs now.

faq.a: If you are unsure, book a consultation or send an enquiry. The right choice depends on sensitivity, congestion, goals and timing.

faq.q: Can I book before an event?
faq.a: Yes, but leave appropriate time—especially for peels or extraction. Ask the clinic for a personalised timeline.

treatments.name: Laser Hair Removal
treatments.intro: A course-led route to reducing unwanted facial or body hair with flexible single-area and package options.

faq.q: Do I need a patch test?
faq.a: Patch testing and suitability should be confirmed before starting a laser course.
Current package listings use six sessions with one session free for selected areas.

treatments.name: Filler Dissolving

home.aboutParagraph1: Every appointment is led by Fatima from her private Salford clinic, with a focus on facial harmony, calm consultation and results that still feel like you.
home.aboutParagraph2: There is no one-size-fits-all plan. Fatima considers your features, lifestyle and timing before recommending what will make a genuine difference—and will always say when less is more.

about.heroCopy: Injectox Clinic is led by aesthetic practitioner Fatima Khan from a private Salford clinic serving Greater Manchester.
about.storyTitleLine1: Expertise is not only what you can do.
about.storyTitleLine2: It is knowing when not to.
about.storyParagraph1: Fatima’s work returns to the same principle: the best result is tailored to the person in front of her. That means facial harmony over trends, staged change where appropriate and honest advice when a treatment is not needed.
about.storyParagraph2: The Injectox experience is designed to feel warm, polished and clear—from an informed consultation through aftercare.
about.storyQuote: The goal is not to make you look treated. It is to make the whole picture feel more resolved.

policies.heroCopy: This page summarises key principles. The provider terms displayed during your live booking are the final terms for that appointment.

items.title: Adults only
items.copy: Injectable treatments are presented for clients aged 18 and over. Valid photo ID may be requested.

items.title: Consultation & suitability
items.copy: Treatment is subject to assessment and medical suitability. A booking does not guarantee that treatment will proceed.

items.title: Deposits
items.copy: Paid bookings use Stripe Checkout for a secure deposit. The remaining balance and the clinic’s current cancellation terms are confirmed in your booking email.

items.title: Cancellations
items.copy: Please review the cancellation and rescheduling window shown during booking. Late changes and non-attendance may affect your deposit.

items.title: Laser patch testing
items.copy: A consultation and patch test may be required before laser treatment. Follow all preparation guidance supplied by the clinic.

items.title: Results & aftercare
items.copy: Results and recovery vary. Follow your personalised aftercare and contact the clinic promptly with any concerns.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.intro: The current build is designed to work without marketing cookies. Update this page when analytics or advertising tools are selected.

sections.title: Essential cookies
sections.copy: These may be used where strictly necessary to provide security, remember choices or operate core website features.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.copy: No analytics provider is assumed in this prototype. If analytics is added, document the provider, retention and consent requirements here.

sections.title: External embeds
sections.copy: This build links to Instagram and Faces rather than loading tracking-heavy social embeds automatically. Those sites may set cookies after you follow a link.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.copy: A consent banner should be enabled before any non-essential cookies are deployed. Users should be able to change or withdraw consent at any time.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: A launch-ready framework that must be reviewed against the final hosting, analytics, contact and booking setup.

sections.title: Information collected
sections.copy: The final site may collect information you actively provide through enquiries, along with limited technical data needed for security, analytics and site operation.

sections.title: External booking
sections.copy: Appointments are completed through Faces. Information entered there is processed under that provider’s own privacy terms and not by this website.

sections.title: How information is used
sections.copy: Information should only be used to respond to enquiries, administer services, meet legal obligations and improve the experience where consent or another lawful basis applies.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.copy: UK data-protection rights may include access, correction, erasure, restriction, objection and portability. Add the clinic’s verified privacy contact before launch.

terms.title: Website terms
terms.intro: Plain-language website terms, separate from the treatment and booking terms shown by the appointment provider.

sections.title: Information, not diagnosis
sections.copy: Website content is general information and does not replace an in-person consultation, diagnosis or medical advice.

sections.title: Treatment suitability
sections.copy: Prices, durations and treatment information may change. Treatment proceeds only after assessment and is never guaranteed by an online booking.

sections.title: Results
sections.copy: Images and client stories illustrate individual experiences. Results, longevity, recovery and side effects vary from person to person.

sections.title: External services
sections.copy: Links to booking, finance, maps and social platforms are provided for convenience and are governed by those providers’ terms.

statsSection.copy: Experience across Fatima’s complete client history and verified feedback collected across the clinic’s booking platforms.
